args.title: Fix trailing carriage return handling in parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Handle carriage return (\r) endings when trimming trailing empty lines in parser.ts, ensuring that files ending in \r\n do not trigger a 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Files ending with \r\n have a trailing line ending in \r instead of an empty string, bypassing the pop check and causing a 'Malformed row' error.
